reasons.plausibility: The link between high-temperature phase changes and low-temperature superconductivity is not clearly established but is not inherently contradictory.
reasons.testability: Measuring the property before and after the proposed heat treatments is feasible, but the hypothesis does not specify exactly how superconductivity would be assessed, limiting clarity of the falsification criterion.
reasons.usefulness: While addressing phase stability and diffusion effects provides some insight into potential microstructural influences, it does not strongly connect to the specific mechanism of emergent superconductivity, so its direct utility is limited.
